reply: Thank you for explaining that you received a $1,200.00 online loan at a very high APR and that you believe the lender is not licensed in your state. We understand your concern about the ongoing withdrawals. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please keep your loan agreement and records of each withdrawal. Your state's financial regulator can explain the licensing and rate rules that apply where you live. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that automatic monthly payments were taken from your bank account without any advance notice, and that you first thought the charges were fraud. We understand your confusion. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please ask in writing for a copy of the payment authorization on file and how payment notices are sent, and keep your bank statements. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you paid very high interest across several loans, and that most of each payment went to interest rather than the balance. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please ask in writing for your loan agreements and payment histories, and keep your own records. Your state's financial regulator can explain the interest rate rules that apply where you live. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your interest charges went up while less of your payment went to principal, and that the callback you were told to expect never came. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the loan servicing team. Please send a written request for a payment history showing how each payment was split between principal and interest, and keep copies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your installment loan application was declined for a credit score you believe was wrong, and that the decision then changed after you asked questions. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. If an application is declined based on your credit report, you can ask for the specific reason and the credit report used. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that after your loan application was declined, someone called claiming to be from a known lender and asked you to pay fees to receive a loan. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Legitimate lenders do not ask for upfront fees by phone, so please do not send money and keep a record of the calls. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you dispute an $11,000.00 balance reported for your loan and that you believe the reported amount is inaccurate. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please ask in writing for a full payment history and balance calculation, and dispute any specific inaccurate item with the credit reporting companies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that the response to your earlier complaint about your title loan does not match the repayment terms in your contract or the number of times you refinanced. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please send a written request for copies of your original contract and any refinance agreements, and keep your payment records. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that the website redesign for your solar loan removed the option to set a recurring payment above the minimum. We understand your concern that this makes it harder to pay down the loan. Your complaint has been logged for review by the loan servicing team. Please ask in writing how you can make extra payments toward principal, and keep confirmations of each payment. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a payment was debited in error, and that your request to move a later payment was confirmed and then reversed at the last minute. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please keep notes of each call and the confirmation you were given, and ask in writing for your current payment schedule. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you shared personal information with a company that presented itself as part of a student loan program, and that you now believe it was a scam. We understand how worrying this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please keep the email and claim number, monitor your credit reports, and contact your loan servicer only through official contact details. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you asked for servicemember interest rate benefits on a loan you have paid off, and were told the account does not qualify. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the servicemember benefits team. Please send a written request with your military orders and the loan dates, and ask for the decision and its reasons in writing. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you have paid $570.00 on a $400.00 loan and that the total cost will be much higher, while you are facing hardship. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please ask in writing for a payoff amount and your payment history, and whether a hardship plan is available. Short-term loans can be very costly, so keep your agreement. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $28.00 refund for a returned item was not sent back to your original payment method after your installment plan was completed. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please keep the merchant's refund confirmation and your plan history, and ask in writing where the refund was applied and how it can be returned. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a representative discussed your loan with you at work after you said it was not a good time, and that a repossession agent then came to your workplace. We understand how upsetting this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please write down the dates and what was said, and send a written request asking not to be contacted at work. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a loan was issued for cosmetic procedures you cancelled within hours for medical reasons, and that the procedures were never performed. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep your cancellation emails and your physician's documentation, and send a written dispute asking for the loan to be reviewed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were told you must buy wind insurance or have it bought for you at $8,400.00, after a notice you say you never received. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the home equity team. Please send your current insurance details in writing and ask for copies of all notices sent about the insurance requirement. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that the lender kept trying to debit your closed account and deposit a check after you revoked authorization, and that the calls continued from different numbers. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep your revocation notice and a log of the attempts and calls, and send a written request about how you want to be contacted. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you took out a short-term installment loan with a very high APR and feel trapped by the repayments. We understand how difficult this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please keep your loan agreement and payment records. Your state's financial regulator can explain the licensing and rate rules that apply where you live, and a nonprofit credit counselor may help. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you tried to use your loan program upgrade but could not get help from the store or the bank, and that calls from abroad cost you money. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please send your request in writing, including the eligibility email you received, and ask for written instructions on next steps. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that the merchant received your returned merchandise but did not issue a refund, and that your disputes were closed in the merchant's favor. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep the delivery confirmations and signatures for the returned boxes, and ask in writing for the evidence used to close your dispute. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your order was cancelled but the loan remains open, and that you have been told the refund could take two months. We understand your concern about your credit report. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please keep the cancellation confirmation, and ask in writing when the loan will be closed and how it will be reported. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your $30,000.00 personal loan was deposited and then reversed, and that each bank says the other has the funds. We understand how worrying this is. Your complaint has been logged for urgent review by the lending team. Please keep your bank's account history and notes of each call, and ask both banks in writing to trace the reversed funds. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you tried to return a $120.00 loan the same day after deciding you did not need it, and were told you could not repay it for four days. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please ask in writing for the repayment terms in your agreement and the earliest date you can repay without extra charges. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a loan broker created an email account to impersonate you and applied for a loan in your name. We are sorry this happened. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please report the identity theft, keep the sign-in records you have, change your passwords, and check your credit reports for other accounts you do not recognize. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your loan balance does not seem to go down even though you make your payments on time, and sometimes early. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the loan servicing team. Please send a written request for a full payment history showing how each payment was applied, and keep your screenshots and statements. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were told you could refinance your $34,000.00 business loan after paying off half, but your request was declined. We understand the effect this has on your business. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please ask in writing for the reason for the decision and for the refinancing terms in your agreement, and keep your payment records. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that the store picked up the defective chair and processed a full refund, but the loan still shows as owed. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please keep the refund confirmation and pickup records, and send a written request for the refund to be matched to your loan balance. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your travel purchase was refunded within minutes, but the loan was still processed days later. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please keep the refund confirmations from the travel company, and send a written request asking for the loan to be matched against the refund. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $100.00 loan was taken out in your name without your knowledge and that you filed a police report as asked. We are sorry this happened. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please keep the police report and your emails, and check your credit reports for any other accounts you do not recognize. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
